assumptions: One shared Matrix service; Dense and normal owners serialize; at most one accepted full service step per hardware cycle.
Dense primitive count is 4096 host FMA per step; normal is 512; neither mode counter includes the other.
Traffic bound assumes one shared 64-byte/cycle read-plus-write budget. This is an explicit analytical assumption, not verified full-duplex iDMA/DDR throughput.
Metadata, payload and all workspace reads/writes are included exactly once in accepted physical totals; ACK byte counts describe written data, not extra wire traffic.
All waiting, Scalar/SFU and memory latency are omitted; bounds are not feasible whole-cycle predictions.
architecture_bounds.scope: Current cold-M128 mixed Dense/legacy-Attention software mapping; optimistic conditional bounds, not hardware measurement

ddr.mask_contract: Inherited ordinary Down WriteBeat has no mask field; all sixteen FP32 words form an implicit full 64-byte write. Any explicit mask is checked against 0xffffffffffffffff.

matrix.counter_provenance: Actual C++ std::fma calls; no shape-derived or hardware-cycle totals.
